title: Atal Tunnel Connectivity Map
subject: Geography
caption: Map of the Atal Tunnel route showing its connection from Solang Valley (Manali) to Sissu and onward to Ladakh, emphasizing year‑round access.
altText: A detailed textbook‑style map on a white background that traces the Atal Tunnel from Solang Valley near Manali, through the tunnel (shown as a thick red line), to Sissu in Lahaul and Spiti. The map displays surrounding Himalayan terrain, Rohtang Pass, major rivers, and nearby districts, all clearly labelled. An inset map of India highlights the tunnel’s position in the northern Himalayas. A legend, scale bar, and contour lines indicate elevation, and arrows illustrate the tunnel’s year‑round connectivity to Ladakh.
